evidence: agent.py:1106-1114: in the end-of-turn else branch, conversation.add_message(Message(role='assistant', content=response.content or '', provider_content=...)) runs whenever response.content or provider_content, unconditionally before the answer_prose_emitted check at 1119 (comment 1117-1118 says never skip it). The 1119 branch only logs; the elif at 1125 yields. The only other add_message sites are the tool-call branch (703), tool results (1052) and the user message (529), so no hidden-reply path bypasses the append. The conversation is then saved at 1187-1198 via conversation_store.update_conversation, gated by config.auto_save_conversations (default True, config.py:119). The argument-failure break at 1083 has no final reply to hide. Absolute-claim input traced: response.content non-empty with answer_prose_emitted True, which is appended then persisted. Only an operator turning auto_save off skips persistence, which is configured behavior.
